title: Veilforge
tagline: A duskbound idle RPG of remnant crafts, war-arts, and the last workshop under a broken sky.
overall: Wave 12 adds an art-models-assets piece and ships Melvor-style readable SVG glyphs, 18+ monster silhouettes, dungeon gate variants, workshop paperdoll, and complete wanderer attachments. Halt still the only wow; art was the sneer. Merged main review-fix pass (honest offline, vault/PWA/save safety).
